The fastest and most accurate way to track your food. SnapCalorie isn't another complicated calorie counter - just snap a photo or voice note, and get instant nutrition data in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS

Snap a photo of your meal (or dictate a voice note) AI analyzes your food and measures portions. Get instant calories, macros, and 100+ nutrients. That's it. No searching databases. No guessing portion sizes. Just point and track.

WHY SNAPCALORIE IS DIFFERENT

Tired of scrolling through endless food databases? We built something better: AI that identifies your food, measures portions using your iPhone's camera, and pulls verified nutritional data from the USDA database.

See your entire day at a glance. Your visual food timeline makes it easy to spot patterns and stay on track - without the pressure of manual logging.

THE MOST ACCURATE CALORIE TRACKER, PERIOD

SnapCalorie is built differently. While other apps rely on you to search databases and estimate portions, we use computer vision and depth sensors to measure your food directly.

ACCURACY THAT MATTERS

Backed by peer-reviewed research on thousands of measured dishes - That's precise enough to trust your deficit, hit your macros, and actually see results - not just hope you're close enough.

THE MORE YOU USE IT, THE SMARTER IT GETS

SnapCalorie learns from your eating patterns. Always meal prep with chicken thighs? Order the same coffee every morning? The AI adapts to your diet and gets more accurate over time.

PHOTO + VOICE = FASTEST TRACKING EVER

Snap a Photo Point your camera at your plate. Done. Works with home-cooked meals, restaurant dishes, and meal prep.

Or Dictate While You Cook "Two eggs, tablespoon of butter, cup of oatmeal, banana"  -  logged in seconds. Use a kitchen scale and call out weights for laboratory-grade precision. No typing required.

LiDAR Precision (iPhone Pro) Measure exact food volume using depth sensors. The only calorie tracker with this level of technical precision.

TRACK EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS

Calories, protein, carbs, fats, fiber, sugar, sodium, cholesterol, and 100+ micronutrients including vitamins, minerals, and amino acids. Set goals for weight loss, muscle gain, keto, low-carb, high-protein - whatever works for you.

FEATURES THAT SAVE YOU TIME

- AI Food Recognition  -  Identifies thousands of foods instantly
- Nutrition Label Scanner  -  Photograph packaged foods, AI types in the data
- Extensive Food Database  -  500k+ foods verified against USDA data
- Apple HealthKit Integration  -  Sync with your health dashboard
- Custom Goals  -  Macros, micros, calories - track what matters to you
- Visual Timeline  -  See your meals, not just numbers

COOKING OILS & ADJUSTMENTS

Add a quick voice note ("pan-fried in olive oil") or tap to adjust afterward. Edit any prediction instantly - the AI learns from your corrections.

BACKED BY REAL SCIENCE

Founded by ex-Google AI researchers who co-founded Google Lens and Cloud Vision API, SnapCalorie is the only nutrition tracker backed by peer-reviewed academic research. Our Nutrition5k study tested our algorithm on 5,000 unique dishes where every ingredient was weighed. We published the data. We showed our work.

JOIN THOUSANDS OF USERS TRACKING SMARTER

Whether you're trying to lose weight, build muscle, or simply eat healthier, SnapCalorie gives you the fastest, most accurate way to track your nutrition - without the hassle of traditional calorie counters.

Download SnapCalorie today and see why people are ditching manual food logging for good.

results.releaseNotes:
ACTIVITY, IN ONE PLACE
Tap Activity on your home screen and the whole picture opens up: this week at a glance, today's sessions, and two weeks of history. Your Apple Watch workouts arrive on their own — Running, Cycling, Strength, and the rest — right beside the ones you log by hand.

COUNTED ONCE
Apple Health's active energy already includes your Watch workouts, so NutriSnap no longer adds them a second time. A run your Watch recorded and you also logged is one run now. A gym session your Watch never saw still counts in full.

One heads-up: if you sync Apple Health, log workouts by hand, and have "add burned calories to budget" turned on, your daily budget may read a little lower than it used to. The old number was counting the same workout twice.

REVIEW & FIX, REBUILT
The screen you see after every scan finally got the attention it deserved. The photo, the meal name and the totals now live in one card, ingredients read as a clean list, and the full nutrient panel — saturated fat, added sugars, cholesterol, potassium, calcium, iron and vitamin D — shows up where you can actually see it. Editing a saved meal no longer quietly drops those values.

We softened the language too. Portions are an estimate and always were; that's why they're editable. It didn't need saying five times on one screen.

SMALLER THINGS
• Trends, Nutrition and Milestones are a proper segmented control now, so it's obvious you can switch between them
• Slimmer meal headers in Today's diary — a real difference in dark mode
• The ingredient and portion pickers open and close smoothly instead of snapping shut
• The meal picker is easier to read in dark mode
results.description:
Point your camera at your plate and know what's on it — calories, protein, carbs, and fat, estimated in seconds by AI. And NutriSnap shows its work: see every ingredient it found, adjust portions, and fix anything before it's saved.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No selling your data. Your food log stays yours.

Top + Side scan reads two angles for thickness and depth. Rename ingredients, tweak amounts, and add what the camera missed — oil, butter, dressing — with one-tap chips.

Seven fast ways to log: photo scan, voice, barcode, nutrition label, describe it in words, search, or re-log favorites from Recents and My Meals. Say "Hey Siri, log a meal in NutriSnap," or dictate one from your wrist.

EATING OUT? SCAN THE MENU
Point your camera at a restaurant menu and NutriSnap reads it, then ranks the dishes that fit what's left of your day — your remaining calories, your protein target, even your pace. Tap the one you want and it's logged.

EVERY WORKOUT IN ONE PLACE
Tap Activity for the whole picture: this week at a glance, today's sessions, two weeks of history. Apple Watch workouts — Running, Cycling, Strength — arrive beside the ones you log by hand, counted once: a run your Watch tracked isn't added twice, a gym session it never saw earns every calorie.

BEYOND CALORIES: THE FULL PANEL
Scan a barcode or nutrition label and NutriSnap fills in the rest — saturated fat, added sugars, cholesterol, potassium, calcium, iron, and vitamin D, alongside fiber, sugar, and sodium, each against its daily value. Photo scans can't read these, and NutriSnap never guesses: a nutrient the source didn't declare stays blank, never a quiet zero.

THE DIARY IS FREE, AND IT IS STAYING FREE.

Type a meal, scan a barcode, log your weight, set your targets, sync across your devices, export the lot as a file. No trial on it, no counter running down, no account required. Pro buys one thing: reading a plate from a photograph.

HOW IT WORKS

1) Photograph the plate — or a nutrition label, or say what you ate*
2) Get the name, calories, protein, carbs and fat, in about five seconds*
3) Argue with it — "there was no oil", "it was half that" — and the whole reading is recalculated from your sentence

Counting calories fails on the tenth day, when looking up a bowl of soup takes longer than eating it. Kcal AI is built for the tenth day.

This is not another diet app with a plan for you. No coach, nothing to swipe through before you can log lunch. Photograph it, correct it if it is wrong, close the app.

IT TELLS YOU WHEN IT IS UNSURE

A model looking at a photograph cannot see under the sauce, cannot weigh the portion, and cannot know how much oil went into the pan. So a reading it is unsure of is marked as one, instead of every number arriving with the same confidence.

Correcting it takes a sentence, not a form with six fields. A figure you cannot argue with is worse than one you can.

THE PICTURE IS A QUESTION. WE DELETE IT ONCE IT IS ANSWERED.

Your photograph leaves the phone with no name, no account and no identifier attached to it. It is read, and then it is gone — never written to our disk. What we keep is that a reading happened: which kind, which language, whether it worked. Nothing about the food.

WHY COUNT CALORIES?

Everyone has a personalized number of calories they should eat every day based on factors including their weight, height, activity levels, and weight loss/maintenance/gain goals. It’s hard to track calorie intake, though, not least because it’s easy to forget everything you eat during a busy day. Recording your calories as you eat gives you a clearer picture of the calories you are consuming. It also enhances your awareness of food values and nutrient levels, all of which helps you make healthier choices when eating.

HOW CALORY WORKS

Based on your weight, height and activity level, Calory will calculate a suggested daily calorie goal for you. The daily goal will also factor in if you want to maintain, lose or gain weight.
After you know your daily energy requirements, your challenge is to eat the right number of calories. Calory, meanwhile, will remind you throughout the day to record your calorie intake. Even better, there is no registration or sign up required! All the information you enter into Calory is stored on your iCloud, protecting your privacy.

BUILT FOR TRAINING, TOO

PRIVACY

results.description:
MyCals makes calorie and macro tracking simple, fast, and easier to stick with.

Log your food by taking a photo, typing what you ate, scanning a barcode, searching for foods, or adding ingredients manually. Track calories, protein, carbs, fat, water, and weight—all in one place. Whether you want to lose weight, maintain your current weight, build muscle, improve your eating habits, or simply understand your nutrition better, MyCals gives you a clear place to track your day and stay consistent.

Logging meals should not feel like a chore. With MyCals, you can search for foods, add ingredients, adjust portions, scan barcodes, and save meals you eat often so you can log them again faster. Your meals are organized by day and meal type, making it easy to see what you have already eaten and how it fits into your goals.

MyCals Premium makes food logging even faster with AI meal photo scanning. Take a photo of your meal and MyCals can estimate the food items, portions, calories, and macros for you. It is designed to help you move from “I should track this” to “done” in seconds, especially when you are eating meals that are harder to enter manually.

The Progress page helps you understand your habits over time. View daily, weekly, and monthly trends for your calories and macros, follow your water intake, track your weight changes, and see how consistent you have been. MyCals is built to make progress feel visible, not hidden inside complicated charts.

You can also use reminders to stay on track throughout the day. Enable meal reminders, water reminders, weigh-in reminders, or create your own custom notifications based on the habits you want to build.

MyCals is designed around a simple idea: the easier it is to track, the easier it is to stay consistent. Small daily actions add up, and MyCals gives you the tools to make those actions easier to repeat.

MyCals is intended for everyday nutrition and wellness tracking. It is not a medical app and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Nutrition values, AI estimates, barcode results, and food data may not always be accurate. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making significant changes to your diet, health, or fitness routine.

Download MyCals and start building a clearer, easier way to track your nutrition.
